staticText: Private Unicode-aware word and character counter with assignment minimum and maximum checks, editable reading, speaking, and page assumptions, repeated-phrase frequency, and summary export. Institutional word-count rules can differ for citations, headings, numbers, apostrophes, and hyphens. Character counts use Unicode code points, so combined accents and emoji may differ in another submission system. Flesch estimates are shown only for a sufficient mostly-English sample and are reading-complexity heuristics, not quality, intelligence, academic-grade, or SEO verdicts. Draft text stays in the current browser tab and must be excluded from analytics, URLs, and exported metric summaries.
